newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks soar to close up nearly two percent.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks soar to close up nearly two percent.

text.p: Tokyo stocks soared to close nearly two percent higher on Friday.
Brokers said that the market was relieved after fears that stock prices may fluctuate due to today's settlement of the September futures and options had been soothed, brokers said.
The key 225-share Nikkei average was up 398.71 points or 1.95 percent to close at 20,842.64. Its December futures jumped 270 points to end at 20,870.
